title: Food Logix — Membership approval and Stripe Billing
description: Proposed business journey. Company approval comes before payment, paid membership activates only from verified Stripe events, and company verification remains separate.

slides.title: 1. Apply without payment
slides.caption: A company chooses Explorer, Pro, Premium or Enterprise and submits an application. No payment or member access is granted at this point.
messageCaptions: The applicant chooses the intended membership and submits business information.
Convex records the requested tier and pending review.
The applicant receives an acknowledgement, not a payment request.
slides.chart:
sequenceDiagram
  actor C as Company
  participant W as Food Logix
  participant D as Convex
  participant E as Email
  C->>W: Select plan and apply
  W->>D: Store pending application and tier
  D->>E: Queue confirmation
  E-->>C: Application received

slides.title: 2. Company review
slides.caption: Food Logix reviews the applicant. A declined application receives a notice and does not proceed to checkout.
messageCaptions: An authorized Food Logix administrator evaluates the business.
The approval or decline decision is audited.
The applicant is informed of the decision.
slides.chart:
sequenceDiagram
  actor A as Food Logix Admin
  participant W as Food Logix
  participant D as Convex
  participant E as Email
  actor C as Company
  A->>W: Review application
  W->>D: Record approval or decline
  D->>E: Queue decision notice
  E-->>C: Approved or declined

slides.title: 3. Explorer activates for free
slides.caption: For approved Explorer applications, the membership activates without Stripe checkout. Company verification and listing approval remain separate.
messageCaptions: The free Explorer plan is approved.
Convex activates Explorer entitlements.
The applicant receives account access instructions.
slides.chart:
sequenceDiagram
  actor A as Food Logix Admin
  participant D as Convex
  participant E as Email
  actor C as Company
  A->>D: Approve Explorer application
  D->>D: Activate free membership
  D->>E: Queue welcome email
  E-->>C: Explorer access active

slides.title: 4. Paid plan receives payment link
slides.caption: For approved Pro ($2,500/year), Premium ($5,000/year) or Enterprise ($10,000/year), create a customer-specific secure Stripe Checkout link. Approval alone never grants paid access.
messageCaptions: Food Logix approves the paid application.
The backend records approved but pending payment.
Stripe creates a customer-bound Checkout Session for the server-selected annual plan.
The applicant receives a personalized secure link.
slides.chart:
sequenceDiagram
  actor A as Food Logix Admin
  participant D as Convex
  participant S as Stripe Billing
  participant E as Email
  actor C as Company
  A->>D: Approve paid application
  D->>D: Mark approved pending payment
  D->>S: Create customer and Checkout Session
  S-->>D: Secure checkout URL
  D->>E: Send payment invitation
  E-->>C: Personalized payment link

slides.title: 5. Verified payment activates membership
slides.caption: The backend verifies Stripe's signed paid-invoice event, checks plan and company mapping, and deduplicates retries. A successful browser redirect alone is not proof of payment.
messageCaptions: The company pays through Stripe-hosted Checkout.
Stripe sends a signed payment webhook to Convex.
Convex verifies and deduplicates the event before activating the matching plan.
The company receives confirmation and accesses its membership with Clerk sign-in.
slides.chart:
sequenceDiagram
  actor C as Company
  participant S as Stripe Billing
  participant D as Convex
  participant E as Email
  participant K as Clerk Auth
  C->>S: Pay securely
  S-->>D: Signed invoice.paid webhook
  D->>D: Verify event and company mapping
  D->>D: Activate paid entitlement once
  D->>E: Queue confirmation
  E-->>C: Membership active
  C->>K: Sign in
  K-->>D: Verified company identity
  D-->>C: Authorized dashboard

slides.title: 6. Renewals, failures and cancellation
slides.caption: Annual renewal events update the paid-through date. Failed payments, subscription cancellation and expiration follow an explicit grace-period and notification policy. Verified badges and listing moderation are not payment entitlements.
messageCaptions: Stripe sends signed renewal or failed-payment events.
Convex applies idempotent renewal, grace-period or expiry rules.
The company receives the relevant billing notification.
slides.chart:
sequenceDiagram
  participant S as Stripe Billing
  participant D as Convex
  participant E as Email
  actor C as Company
  S-->>D: Signed renewal or failure event
  D->>D: Apply subscription lifecycle policy
  D->>D: Extend or restrict paid entitlements
  D->>E: Queue billing update
  E-->>C: Renewal or action required
